source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP_GB_RTM1~8 should get pass result.

original_test_intent: With the required accelerator driver active, exercise and independently verify all eight GPU-baseboard RTM temperature channels through approved warning and critical thresholds, including correct SEL/protection behavior and component, link and host recovery.
original_method: The preserved Master explicitly uses `ipmitool sdr elist` and `ipmitool sensor list` while an engineer controls the thermal condition; it does not require raw IPMI bytes. RTM meaning and each channel's physical/link domain remain Project-specific.
manual_activity: An engineer defines RTM for the actual platform, maps eight sensors to physical components and any associated data-link domains, confirms the supported read interface, approves a stimulus that reaches each applicable channel, and owns abort and recovery.
required_inputs: RTM definition and RTM1-8 physical component, SDR, board, accelerator and link-domain map
proof that standard SDR/sensor reads expose the channels or Project approval for a documented vendor decoder/read-only interface
validated accelerator, retimer or other mapped-component firmware, driver and telemetry versions
per-channel limits, accuracy, hysteresis, SEL event data and expected fan/throttle/power/link/shutdown response
traffic/workload, chamber or fixture coupling matrix with ramp, dwell, maximum, abort and cooldown
independent probes plus link rate/width/error, power/fan, log-retention and recovery ownership
safety_requirements: Do not issue guessed raw IPMI bytes; the Master high-level commands have precedence unless Project documentation proves another supported read-only path is required.
Do not assume RTM means retimer. If Project confirms retimers, map every device to exact upstream/downstream links and monitor link integrity before applying traffic or heat.

Continuously monitor all RTM temperatures, independent probes, accelerator/component power, fans, XID/driver state and, where applicable, PCIe/fabric link width/rate, AER/replay/error counters; abort on overshoot, retrain, link degradation or device loss.
Preserve first per-channel SEL, link and device failure evidence; do not clear logs or auto-retry.
Stop traffic/stimulus, restore cooling and verify every mapped component and link recovers before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, enumerate RTM1-8 through the supported standard or vendor interface and bind each to physical component, SDR and any link domain.
Run only the approved traffic/workload or monitor engineer-operated thermal equipment while collecting synchronized temperatures, SEL, power/fan, device and link-health evidence.
Produce eight independent rows for threshold assert/deassert, protection, link/device behavior, cooldown and recovery; no single channel or event substitutes for another.
Do not invent raw commands, infer component identities, apply physical heat, exceed the envelope, clear evidence, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve RTM semantics, eight-channel topology, supported read path, stack, stimulus coupling, event/protection matrix and recovery.
Operate physical stimulus with oversight and emergency abort authority.
Resolve any link/component degradation and issue per-channel plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The placeholder safely avoids invented raw bytes but incorrectly says raw bytes are required. The Master already supplies standard SDR/sensor reads; their availability must be checked before any Project-approved alternative is considered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Start with trusted `ipmitool sdr elist` and `ipmitool sensor list`; if the platform does not expose RTM channels, use only a documented Project-approved read-only vendor interface with decoder metadata.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The driver note, RTM1~8 range, high-level IPMI commands, threshold-crossing intent, script and 5/10-minute values remain preserved; no raw bytes are added to the public case.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT RTM MAP AND SUPPORTED READ PATH REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map all eight RTM channels, verify the supported read interface, qualify a component/link-coupled stimulus, correlate each SEL/protection response, then cool and prove component and link recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact GPU baseboard, RTM component population, accelerator/interconnect topology and cooling design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BMC/SDR, accelerator, RTM-component firmware, driver, telemetry tool, decoder and stimulus versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor RTM component/sensor map, supported BMC read interface, thermal limits, event mapping and link/device recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds eight-channel component/link identity and supported-interface validation without replacing the Master commands with guessed raw IPMI.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic GPU temperature or a subset of RTM readings cannot prove all eight component channels and their associated links recovered.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: RTM map, supported interface, qualified stimulus, limits/events and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If RTM channels are retimer-related, traffic or local heating can cause link errors or device loss before the BMC sensor crosses a critical threshold.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve a vendor decoder or raw read only when it records the original standard commands, why they lack equivalent visibility, the exact read-only interface, privilege and coverage equivalence. It may not invent raw bytes or claim unobserved channels.
expected_evidence: RTM1-8 component, SDR, board, accelerator and conditional link-domain identity matrix
standard-command availability result or approved vendor read-interface/decoder contract
approved traffic/workload or fixture coupling, probe and abort plan
timestamped eight-channel temperatures, power/fan, accelerator/device and conditional link width/rate/AER/replay/error evidence
decoded warning/critical SEL assert/deassert entries separately attributed to every applicable RTM channel
cooldown, per-channel deassertion, component/link/device/host/BMC recovery and engineer verdicts

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target range, dynamic operation and criteria are identifiable. Exact RTM component mapping, supported read interface, stack and stimulus values are supplyable Project inputs. Attended setup plus automated eight-channel monitoring is therefore conditionally executable.

The dynamic stimulus remains attended; sensor, SEL, device and link correlation can be automated after those readiness inputs are supplied.
